Our research, development and premium quality products have made us a pioneer in the field, with our clientele in over 125 countries around the globe. We are a government recognized Two Star Export House with an ISO 9001-2015 certification , Global Recycled Standard certification and most importantly Oeko- Tex Certified. At Saanika, the strategic focus revolves around consistent value creation through innovation, Quality certification, cost optimization, integration, product mix value addition and superior technology. We seek to innovate persistently and use the best quality raw material that imparts desirable durability and strength to the textile yarns which makes us renowned. Products Customer Satisfaction is a measure of product quality. Keeping pace with the growing demands for premium quality yarns, we at Saanika Industries strive hard to manufacture and supply texturized yarns, twisted yarns, dyed yarn, intermingle yarns, etc. that match with the needs of the customers and confirming to the international standards. We also manufacture and export wide variety of knitted fabrics with GSM ranging from 80 to 300 (as per requirement) Spandex and Non spandex, With composition of 3% to 20% ( as per requirement) Knitted Fabric Melange Yarn Carpet Yarn Kota Yarn Draw Textured Yarn (DTY) Air Textured Yarn (ATY) Spandex / Lycra Yarn Knitted Fabric Melange Yarn Carpet Yarn Kota Yarn Draw Textured Yarn (DTY) Air Textured Yarn (ATY) Spandex / Lycra Yarn Knitted Fabric Why Choose Us? Ltd. The Company was established by our Chairman Mr. Om Prakash Agarwal in the year 1991 with the primary aim of providing quality yarns for textile and apparel industries for the domestic market and then on with the joining of Mr. Sumit Agarwal as the Managing Director from its humble beginning as a textile company we became a renowned name and a leader in the domestic market and then gradually as one of the leading exporters of Polyester Yarn, Saanika industries has come a long way. The company has already attained the recognition as a Government certified “Two Star Export House” . With strategic planning and perfect implementation to go hand in hand with the latest technology we invested into modern plant and machinery to achieve global competitiveness both in terms of quality and cost structure. Saanika Polytex Pvt. Ltd. We expanded our wings with new manufacturing unit under the company name Saanika Polytex Pvt. Ltd. in the year 2019 manufacturing DTY Yarn and ventured in the field of Manufacturing of Knitted Fabrics with 100 machines and production capacity of 1000 ton per month and products ranging from 80 to 300 GSM (as per customer requirement). In short period of time Saanika Polytex has established its name in Yarn and Knitted Fabrics in Domestic and International Market.
